title.fr: Équilibre d'un solide assujetti à tourner autour d'un axe fixe

formula: Σ M_Δ(F_ext) = 0   (moments par rapport à l'axe Δ)
sketch:
Observe: SVG lever pivoted at Δ, with two hangable weights P₁, P₂ at
distances d₁, d₂ from axis. Student drags weights along the arm; a
moments panel shows M₁ = P₁·d₁ and M₂ = P₂·d₂ with signs; a
tilt-indicator swings until M₁ = M₂ (théorème des moments).
Experiment: 3 seeded (P₁, d₁, P₂) triples; student sets d₂ to balance.
Evaluate: moments panel hidden; student sets d₂ from arithmetic alone;
the lever "settles" only if within tolerance. Wrinkle: sign of moment
(couple horaire vs. anti-horaire).
